ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity (white) pixels dominate approximately 70% of the visible surface, contrasted against low-intensity (black) pixels localized primarily at the trailing edges and medial notch.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central lobes exhibit contiguous high-intensity white blobs. Low-intensity black pigmentation forms a solid band along the trailing edge (depth varying from 5-15% of lobe height) with irregular mottling extending inward towards the fluke center, particularly dense around the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: A narrow V-shaped depression is present; however, the precise vertex angle and depth are partially obscured by water-surface turbulence and white-water spray.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations visible along the entire continuous trailing edge. The right lobe (image right) shows higher-amplitude jagged peaks (approx. 3-8 pixel depth) compared to the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edges of both lobes follow a convex curve, sweeping upward and outward from the median notch toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Several dark, roughly circular clusters are visible within the white high-intensity regions of the mid-left lobe and the upper-right lobe near the trailing edge.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous distinct, unaligned dark linear streaks (rake marks) are detected. A cluster of diagonal lines is visible on the left lobe, and intersecting vertical/diagonal lines are prominent on the mid-to-right section of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear rake marks across both lobes and significant irregular serration/notching on the distal trailing edge of the right lobe.
